title: HelperSSHConnectionParams
description: Ask which connection a destination's shell will ride (nocx-oalo1.5.3). It is a question with NO side effect: the helper derives the same supervisor key its own `spawn-ssh` acquire will use, from the resolved destination alone — no credential is resolved, no socket is dialed, no person is asked — and answers it. That is what lets a coordinator bind a pane to its connection BEFORE the shell exists, so the pane's first `pane.connection` arrives while the dial is still opening (design §5.5). The destination is the same shape every other op takes, for the reason those ops share it: a connection's identity includes the route and the credential principal, and a loose copy of the address would name a different connection.

destination.description: The resolved destination whose connection is asked about. Resolved by the coordinator, which reads ~/.ssh/config and holds the credential binding; the helper only turns it into the identity the pool keys a connection by.
